question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**market**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses tea prices in the domestic context, which implies a focus on the economic aspect.
 
• The word "market" is appropriate here as it refers to an area or arena in which commercial dealings are conducted.
 
• "**Market**" fits well because it aligns with the context of pricing, production, and trend analysis in the domestic economy.
 
• Other options such as "area", "zone", and "field" do not specifically relate to the economic and commercial activities being discussed.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Tea prices in the domestic **market__** continue to rule high in the current year despite the expectation of a higher production as compared to the previous year. During the past three months, tea prices have been **__in line__** with the prices of other companies. Unlike last year, tea prices have generally shown **__stability__**, when tea prices rose dramatically, this year, prices seem to have **__stabilized__** at a rather high level. In the subsequent four months, the **__overall__** average price showed a downtrend.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Area (क्षेत्र): **"Area" refers to a region or part of a town, a country, or the world, which is too general for this context.
 
• **Zone (अंचल): **"Zone" denotes an area of division with specific characteristics, which does not fit the economic implication.
 
• **Field (क्षेत्र): **"Field" relates to an area of knowledge, interest, or activity, which does not match the commercial context of tea prices.
